essence: A well-devoted person becomes devoted again in every birth.
The speaker now wishes to hear the previously indicated armor.
The lord alone is the refuge who can protect from suffering and danger.
The armor named Śrījaganmaṅgala has a mantra as its body.
By wearing this armor Nārāyaṇa became a woman in relation to Maheśvara.
